theorems.type:
∀ (cursor tail anchor delay : _root_.Nat) (w : _root_.Option _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Witness)
    (execution : _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Singleton), _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.step cursor tail anchor delay w execution =
      if cursor ≥ tail then
        if w.isNone then _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.accepted cursor else _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.rejected
      else match w with
      | .none => _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.rejected
      | .some w =>
        if w.index ≠ cursor ∨ !w.storageAuthenticated ∨ w.rawBytes > 8192 ∨
          (w.rawBytes ≠ 0 ∧ w.rawHash ≠ w.stored.txHash) then _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.rejected
        else if w.firstHash = _root_.Option.some w.stored.txHash ∧ w.firstCanonical = _root_.Bool.true ∧
            w.firstBytes ≤ 8192 then _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.accepted (cursor+1)
        else if anchor < w.stored.timestamp+delay then _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.accepted cursor
        else if w.rawHash ≠ w.stored.txHash ∨ w.rawBytes > 8192 then _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.rejected
        else if w.canonical = _root_.Bool.false then _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.accepted (cursor+1)
        else match execution with
          | .unavailable => _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.waiting
          | .completedRetained | .inconsistent => _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.rejected
          | .completedEmpty => _root_.Etna.Design.Forced.Result.accepted (cursor+1)

theorems.scope: Scope counterexample, not a failure of H1-H3: open design issue: late stake can capture a recovery committee. On an initialized deployment with n_max 5 and four honest parties, the committee a recovery would elect at authorization passes the modelled parts of 8.1's check (nonempty, every party below 1/3; online power, history and signers are not modelled); recover binds no registry bound, so stake registered after the authorization and active by R joins the committee the model elects at R (recovery schedule and built generation-1 rules): here it holds 9/13 of the power and alone signs a valid commit. Suggested fix: a maxActiveFromL1 bound in the authorization.
